name: What are the advantages of a freestanding pergola versus an attached pergola?
description: Freestanding pergolas offer flexible placement, while attached ones extend living space directly from your home with fewer supports.

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of a freestanding pergola versus an attached pergola?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freestanding pergolas offer flexibility in placement, allowing them to be a focal point anywhere in your yard and providing shade in various locations. Attached pergolas are secured to your home, often extending your living space directly from a patio or deck, which can be more cost-effective as they typically require fewer support posts. The practical tradeoff is largely about versatility versus seamless integration with your home's structure. During our consultation, we can help determine which option best suits your space and lifestyle.
